description: Source code for CCSP interface handling, including initialization, parameter retrieval, component discovery, and event registration for telemetry in a CCSP-based system.

methods.name: CCSPInterface_Init
methods.description: Initializes the CCSP message bus and sets up the bus handle.

methods.name: findDestComponent
methods.description: Discovers the destination component supporting a given parameter name.

methods.name: ccspGetParameterValues
methods.description: Retrieves parameter values from the CCSP bus for given parameter names.

methods.name: getCCSPParamVal
methods.description: Gets the value of a specific CCSP parameter.

methods.name: getCCSPProfileParamValues
methods.description: Retrieves a list of profile parameter values for a list of parameters.

methods.name: registerCcspT2EventListener
methods.description: Registers a callback for CCSP telemetry events.

methods.name: unregisterCcspT2EventListener
methods.description: Unregisters the telemetry event listener (stub implementation).

methods.name: isCCSPInitialized
methods.description: Checks if the CCSP bus handle has been initialized.
